[ASSISTANT_SAID] Korg and Roland are excellent brands for keyboards with amazing features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested Korg options: Korg B1 ($499), Korg Grandstage ($799), Korg D1 ($699).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested Roland options: Roland FP-10 ($799), Roland FP-30 ($999), Roland GO:KEYS ($499).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] All suggested keyboards have USB connectivity for MIDI and DAW use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended effective practice tips for ukulele: set specific goals, warm-up, focus on technique, practice in small chunks, slow and deliberate practice, practice regularly, listen and record yourself.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips for improving chord changes on the ukulele: start with simple chords, practice chord shapes, use a metronome, practice chord progressions, focus on finger independence, slow changes, practice with a drone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips for improving fingerpicking technique: relaxation, finger independence, finger assignment, start with simple patterns, focus on fingertip, use nails, practice with a metronome, listen to fingerpicking masters, practice with different rhythms, be patient.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended to ask Joe to check or fix: action adjustment, neck relief, fretboard and frets, bridge and saddle, intonation, string height and spacing, electronics, body and neck joints, tuning machines.
